pages.title: Saturation Modifier
pages.text: Depending on how the mod is configured, foods that are unseasoned may receive a saturation penalty. Similarly, seasoned foods will grant extra saturation, depending on the diversity of the used spices. When a seasoned food ends up with no effects, it ends up with a "participation award" saturation boost.

pages.title: Saturation Modifier
pages.text: If the mod $(l:https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)AppleSkin$() is installed, its tooltip will show the corrected saturation value. The HUD overlay over the hunger bar shows the unmodified value though.
